name: Inside Power Duo (Double Teams)
formation: Gun 3x1 Trips Right, Offset RB Left

summary.motive: Impose pure physical will at the line of scrimmage with interior Duo double teams, blowing defensive tackles off the ball and creating a heavy north-south running lane.
summary.whyItWorks: Double-teaming both interior defensive linemen creates massive vertical displacement, leaving linebackers hesitant and easily climbed upon by guards.
summary.failureMode: A penetrating 3-technique DT splitting the RG/RT double-team before the combination can establish vertical push.

beats.title: 1. The Dual Interior Double Teams
beats.text: Philadelphia’s offensive line unleashes violent synchronized double teams: LG & C strike the 1-tech NT while RG & RT hammer the 3-tech DT, moving the defensive front backwards.

beats.title: 2. Vertical Displacement of the Defensive Line
beats.text: Both defensive tackles are blasted 2+ yards off the line of scrimmage, creating an impenetrable wall and swallowing up the interior gaps.

beats.title: 3. The Second-Level Climb & Mike Collision
beats.text: LG and RG seamlessly peel off their displaced defensive tackles to seal Mike and Will linebackers, opening a massive vertical crevice directly through the A-gap.

beats.title: 4. Physical North-South Explosion
beats.text: The running back hits the A-gap with high knees and north-south velocity, breaking through arm tackles for a punishing 9-yard gain.

relations.tell: Gun 3x1 formation with offensive line firing straight ahead on vertical power angles without pulling guards.
